desc:
100% cold, and 120% sweet. The maker says it's his best custom W-Engine of the year. "So, Miss Zhao, what do you think? I've named this one 'Full-Sugar Bunny.' Fits your style, right? Huh? Change it to Half-Sugar? But why...? Ah, no no, you're the client, you get to name it however you like!"

<color=#959595>"Equivalent exchange means finding a balance — not a bit more, not a bit less." —That was Xiao'Zhao's answer after Dialyn asked her several times, "What's wrong with full-sugar?"</color>
desc2: Equip to increase Defense Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: Not too sweet, and not too cold.
name: Half-Sugar Bunny

1.desc: The equipper's Energy Regen increases by <color=#2BAD00>0.46</color>/s. All squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> ATK and <color=#2BAD00>10%</color> Max HP. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad. When the equipper activates or extends an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, all squad members gain <color=#2BAD00>30%</color> CRIT DMG for 60s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
1.name: Fragile Sweetness
